title: social media rabbit holes, clusters, and the relative mixing times of random walks
summary: 本文探讨社交媒体中的信息茧房现象，通过随机游走的相对混合时间分析，指出社交平台如Twitter并非公共广场，而是类似高中食堂的分散小团体，用户容易陷入特定话题的兔子洞。
highlights: Twitter isn't a town square, it's a high school cafeteria.
Social media rabbit holes and clusters are analyzed via relative mixing times of random walks.
The article provides a mathematical perspective on how users get trapped in echo chambers.
